description: This file implements a test mode adapter for MAC layer in a 5G NR protocol stack, including classes and methods to simulate and manipulate MAC behavior for testing purposes, such as handling slot indications, CRC/ UCI generation, UL/DL scheduler results, and UE creation.

classes.name: test_ue_mac_sdu_tx_builder_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for MAC SDU TX builder that auto-fills DL buffer state update.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_cell_adapter
classes.description: Implements a MAC cell adapter for test mode, handling slot indications, CRC/ UCI generation, UL/DL results, and UE creation.

classes.name: phy_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: Physical layer test mode adapter managing multiple MAC cells and forwarding scheduler results.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: Main adapter class that wraps the real MAC to enable test mode functionalities, including UE management and message handling.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot timing indications, auto-generates CRC/ UCI, and manages UE state updates.

methods.name: handle_crc
methods.description: Processes CRC indication messages, forcing success for test UEs, and forwards to real MAC.

methods.name: forward_crc_ind_to_mac
methods.description: Forwards CRC indication messages to the underlying MAC layer.

methods.name: handle_uci
methods.description: Processes UCI indication messages, modifies for test UEs, and forwards to real MAC.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Intercepts and processes downlink scheduler results, updating test UEs accordingly.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Intercepts UL scheduler results, updates history, and forwards results.

methods.name: on_cell_results_completion
methods.description: Handles completion of cell results, manages UE creation for test UEs.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell in test mode, creating associated adapters and managing UE creation.

methods.name: remove_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from test mode, disconnecting and cleaning up.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Returns the result notifier for a specific cell.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the test mode PHY adapter to a specific cell.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the PHY adapter from a specific cell.

methods.name: create_du_high_mac
methods.description: Factory function to create a MAC instance in test mode if configured, wrapping the real MAC.
